## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Snow Moon Caitlyn.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Snow Moon Caitlyn

**Affects**: Textures, VFX

Done as a commission. Supposed to make her look like a part of the Ashen Knights universe. Includes post-ult glow and idle particles (bottom right on the thumbnail). You can watch the skin preview [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GDeriis6eDU).
